githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.7 Beta 10 keeps your drafts in threads, forum posts and channels you jump straight back into, and makes search inside DMs and group DMs suggest the right people in Discord's order. It also shows custom emoji in reply previews, opens videos in the viewer on double-click, and fixes photo colours shifting on hover and the chat drifting while you select text. Under the hood, much of the codebase has been reorganised.

## Drafts

- Fixed drafts in threads and forum posts being lost when you opened another thread, closed the side panel or switched channels. They are now saved and restored like channel drafts.
- Fixed typing straight after returning to a channel replacing its saved draft. The draft now appears immediately instead of loading a moment later.

## Search

- Fixed search inside a DM or group DM suggesting people from outside the conversation. From and Mentions suggestions now list only its members, with you last, in the same order as Discord.
- Changed From and Mentions matching to follow Discord: text after a # is ignored, a leading @ is kept, and a search with no matches shows no suggestions instead of an empty heading.

## Messages and media

- Added custom emoji images to reply previews and thread cards, which used to show the emoji's :name:.
- Added opening a video in the built-in viewer by double-clicking it, whether it is still a thumbnail or already playing. A single click still plays it in place.
- Fixed photos looking more saturated at rest than when hovered. They now show the same colours either way.
- Fixed the chat slowly scrolling while you drag to select text. It now scrolls only when you drag past the visible top or bottom edge, including down onto the message box.

## Under the hood

- Refactored large parts of the codebase, including the message timeline, composer, forum board, member list, read state and settings, so shared logic now lives in one place. These changes aren't meant to change behaviour; if something works differently from Beta 9, please report it.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.7-Beta-9...v0.1.7-Beta-10](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.7-Beta-9...v0.1.7-Beta-10)
discordAnnouncement:
**Drafts that stick around, and smarter DM search 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Drafts in threads and forum posts now survive switching away, and channel drafts no longer vanish if you start typing the moment you return
- Searching inside a DM or group DM only suggests its members, in the same order as Discord
- Custom emoji now show as images in reply previews and thread cards
- Double-click a video to open it in the viewer
- Photos keep the same colours when you hover them, and selecting text no longer makes the chat drift
- A big round of behind-the-scenes cleanup across the timeline, composer and forums
